article.title_es: Beulah Church of God in Christ Jesus: despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn
article.title_en: Beulah Church of God in Christ Jesus: food pantry in Brooklyn
article.summary_es: La iglesia Beulah Church of God in Christ Jesus aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos en Brooklyn, en la avenida Marcy.
article.summary_en: Beulah Church of God in Christ Jesus appears on the Food Help NYC map as a food pantry in Brooklyn, on Marcy Avenue.
how_they_help_es: Aparece en el mapa oficial Food Help NYC como despensa de alimentos.
Ofrece servicio de despensa los martes y jueves.
Está ubicada en 956 Marcy Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11216.
Tiene un teléfono para llamar antes de ir: (718) 636-8500.
how_they_help_en: Listed on the official Food Help NYC map as a food pantry.
Offers pantry service on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Located at 956 Marcy Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11216.
Has a phone number to call ahead: (718) 636-8500.
visit_tips_es: Horario de despensa: martes 10:30am-1pm y jueves 10:30am-1pm.
La lista no indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; llame al (718) 636-8500 para preguntar.
Verifique el horario antes de viajar, ya que puede cambiar.
visit_tips_en: The listing does not say what food is given or if there are requirements; call (718) 636-8500 to ask.
Check the hours before traveling, since they can change.
